blocks.text: Ecosystem mein jandar khane ke groups mein tarteeb diye jate hain jinhein trophic levels kehte hain.

items: Trophic level 1: sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria, yaani primary producers.
Trophic level 2: primary consumers (sabzi khor) jo seedha producers khate hain, jaise keere aur khargosh.
Trophic level 3: secondary consumers (gosht khor) aur janwaron ke parasites jo sabzi khoron ko khate hain, jaise mendak aur saanp.
Trophic level 4: tertiary consumers, gosht khoron ko khane wale janwar, jaise bheriye aur baaz.
Decomposers aur detritivores, kitab ki misalon mein kekre, gidh aur gidar, alag level banate jo baqi sab par palta hai, detritus (murda galta maadda) aur fuzla kha kar.

blocks.alt: Chaar trophic levels ka ahram: bunyad par producers (sabz paude, algae), phir primary consumers (keere, khargosh), secondary consumers (mendak, saanp) aur choti par tertiary consumers (baaz, bheriya). Saath har level tak pohanchne wali tawanai 10,000 se 1,000, 100 aur 10 kcal, har qadam par taqreeban 10%.
blocks.caption: Trophic levels aur har level tak pohanchne wali tawanai (Figures 25.4 aur 25.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ecosystem ke jandar khane ke groups, trophic levels, mein tarteeb diye jate hain: producers (sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria), primary consumers yaani sabzi khor, sabzi khoron ko khane wale secondary consumers, aur gosht khoron ko khane wale tertiary consumers, jab ke decomposers aur detritivores har level ke murda maadde par palte hain. Producers apne par girne wali dhoop ka sirf 1-2% jama karte, aur aik level ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 10% agle tak jata hai; baqi zyada tar garmi ban kar zaya hota hai. Kitab ki misaal mein producers ki 10,000 kcal se primary consumers ko 1,000, secondary ko 100 aur tertiary ko taqreeban 10 kcal milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Khargosh kis trophic level par hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Trophic level 2: yeh primary consumer (sabzi khor) hai jo seedha producers khata hai.

items: Producers, primary, secondary, tertiary consumers; decomposers sab levels par palte.
